channel.title: Business Recorder - Markets
channel.description: Markets and economy news from Business Recorder

item.title: KSE-100 rallies over 400 points amid heavy foreign buying
item.description: The benchmark KSE-100 index closed sharply higher on Friday, led by gains in banking, cement and energy sector stocks.

item.title: Gold prices edge up in local market tracking global trend
item.description: Gold prices in Pakistan rose on Thursday in line with a firmer trend in international bullion markets.

item.title: Textile exports post modest growth in July on higher orders
item.description: Pakistan's textile exports rose slightly in July compared to the previous month, driven by higher orders from European buyers.

item.title: Current account posts small surplus for second straight month
item.description: The State Bank reported a modest current account surplus for July, aided by steady remittances and lower imports.

item.title: Cement dispatches rise on the back of construction demand
item.description: Local cement dispatches increased in July, industry data showed, as construction activity picked up across major cities.
